== Trivia ==
* This skill is named after the [[Canthan Heroes|Canthan hero]], [[Teinai]].
* This and [[Ward Against Harm]] are the only Elementalist ward spells outside of [[Earth Magic]].
* This is the only Elementalist ward spell without "ward" in its name.
* The [[functionality]] of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Teinai's Heat/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
